metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: One unrandomized cell on a shared host. Source gallery chrome and unrelated English menus remain outside the task. Local storage and synthetic save fixture only. Chromium, emulated touch and sampled frames; no physical mobile keyboard, other engine, screen reader, natural-time playback or human study. Native resolved model, usage, billing and context-pressure telemetry unavailable.
